title: Non-freeness of groups generated by two parabolic elements with small rational parameters
annotation:
Normalization: $a = \mat1011$, $b_q = \mat1q01$, $G_q = \gen{a, b_q}$. The question is whether $G_q$ is non-free for every nonzero rational $q$ with $\abs{q} < 4$.

From the abstract: if $q = s/r$ with $\abs{s} \le 27$, then $G_q$ is non-free, except possibly for $s = 24$; for $s = 24$ the denominators $r$ giving a non-free group have natural density $1$. Some proofs are computer assisted.
